lines: It feels like the goodbye happened
much longer ago than it did
I sealed away the sorrowful light
and wore the heels off my shoes
When I was with you, I could see it
now I can't see it anymore
a transparent comet, dim and hazy
but that alone is what I keep searching for
I was always singing songs
melodies that existed only in that moment
I wasn't lonely, not at all
because I could truly feel lonely
How long, how far —
whether it's normal or not —
there's no time to even think about it; walking is hard enough
Being happy is far better
I'll keep smiling, papering over it
It's all right
that pain — even if I forget it, it won't disappear
The road I built out of longing
reality keeps painting over
but on the path of that trace, my memories
remain, turned to light
Why did we say goodbye —
what was it for, I wonder
The sorrowful light stretches my shadow
long out in front of me
Sometimes I run a fever
When I have time, I sleep
and inside dreams I know are dreams
I'll meet you, then set out again
Even in endless darkness, far from a clear sky
if I picture a star, I'm at once inside the galaxy
Even if I hardly cry anymore
even if I buy new shoes
It's all right
that pain — even if I forget it, it won't disappear
There must have been something I wanted to tell you
probably something ordinary at that
and yet, this much —
the fact that we said goodbye
is bound to the fact that we met
That transparent comet
is transparent, so it never disappears
Whether it's circle, cross, or triangle
how I measure up against everyone else —
there's no time to even check
being alive is the best thing there is
Even if I hardly cry anymore
I'll keep smiling, papering over it
It's all right
that pain — even if I forget it, it won't disappear
It's all right
at the beginning of this light, there you are
